summary: On a shared build host, scripts/ci-local-web's kit plays wait for a heavy-build slot through the host's build admission (build-admission run heavy kit-play), like a compile, and run at most the cores over the host's heavy slots in browser workers (new KIT_PLAY_WORKERS cap in the kit play gate; unset, as on CI, the gate still fills its machine up to 6). Two kit plays at once had taken every core of a build host. A host without build admission, and CI, run the plays as before.

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: The same plays run; only when they start on a shared host and how many browsers at once.

compatibility.detail: CI is unchanged: KIT_PLAY_WORKERS and KIT_PLAY_ADMISSION_BIN are unset there.
